component.name: Lumenna
component.summary: Tasks, and the blocks of time they are worked in

description.p: Lumenna is a task manager and day planner in one: projects, labels, priorities, subtasks, repeating tasks and quick add, beside a timeline of the day's blocks of time, and a task is put into blocks again and again, across as many sittings as it takes, until it is done.
Every screen is built for screen readers and keyboards first. Your devices sync with each other directly, with no server that sees your tasks.
